programs.title: Barbarians
programs.desc: Four friends come together for a celebratory dinner party at a country house. However, as the night progresses, dark secrets emerge and unsettling events begin to unfold around them.

programs.title: A Lot of Nothing
programs.desc: James and Vanessa are ostensibly the perfect married couple. Their lives spiral out of control when they decide to seek justice against a neighbor they saw commit a crime on the evening news.

programs.title: Inheritance
programs.desc: When Maya learns that her father was once a spy, she suddenly finds herself at the center of an international conspiracy. In her quest for answers, she must travel the globe, mastering her father's skills and unraveling the mysteries of his past.

programs.title: Huda's Salon
programs.desc: A young mother who is married to a jealous man goes to Huda's salon in Bethlehem. However, this ordinary visit turns sour when Huda blackmails the mother to have her work for the secret service of the occupiers, thus betraying her people.

programs.title: Tornado
programs.desc: When her father's puppet samurai show gets ambushed by a notorious gang, Tornado vows to seek vengeance and forge her own destiny by stealing their ill-gotten gold.

programs.title: Bloody Axe Wound
programs.desc: In the small town of Clover Falls, Abbie Bladecut navigates the inheritance of her father's real-life slasher business.

programs.title: Neighborhood Watch
programs.desc: Believing he witnessed an abduction, a young man turns to his next-door neighbor, a retired security guard, to help him find the missing woman.

programs.title: Last Looks
programs.desc: Charlie Waldo is a former cop who left the force to live a life of simplicity and solitude in the woods. Alistair Pinch is an eccentric actor who spends his days drunk on the set of his TV show. When Pinch's wife is found dead, he becomes the prime suspect and convinces Waldo to come out of retirement to investigate what happened. The case finds Charlie contending with gangsters, Hollywood executives and pre-school teachers, all in pursuit of clearing Pinch's name -- or confirming his guilt.

programs.title: American Star
programs.desc: An assassin on his last assignment travels to Fuerteventura to kill a man he's never met.

programs.title: No Man of God
programs.desc: Sentenced to death by electrocution, serial killer Ted Bundy develops a strange and complicated relationship with FBI agent Bill Hagmaier while detailing his heinous crimes.

programs.title: Sympathy for the Devil
programs.desc: Forced to drive a mysterious passenger at gunpoint, a man finds himself in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse where nothing is as it seems.

programs.title: Taurus
programs.desc: A rising but troubled musician searches for the inspiration to record his next song, pushing himself deep into the void.
